lockState.description: The surface can draw the locked state itself (LOCKED-STATE)

surfaceManifest.description: ADD-DEVICE accepts a LAYOUT_MANIFEST describing a complex surface

deviceSerial.description: ADD-DEVICE accepts a SERIAL separate from the DEVICEID

caps.description: CAPS is sent after BEGIN, and the connection is not ready until it has been received

subscriptions.description: Button subscriptions (ADD-SUB, REMOVE-SUB, SUB-PRESS, SUB-ROTATE, SUB-STATE). Can be disabled by the user

configFields.description: ADD-DEVICE accepts CONFIG_FIELDS, with values relayed back via DEVICE-CONFIG

bitmapFormats.description: BITMAP_FORMAT can be negotiated from the comma separated list in CAPS BITMAP_FORMATS

leds.description: Style presets may request `leds` (addressable LED strips/rings), streamed as LEDS

rotaryAmount.description: DIRECTION on KEY-ROTATE and SUB-ROTATE may be a signed step count

escapedValues.description: `\` and `"` inside quoted string values are escaped with a `\`
